rawContent: This isn't exclusively an @edstetzer problem of course, at one point @hannahpaasch and I had a drinking game where we'd send each other the shot glass emoji every time a Christian publication wrote about "Evangelicalism's #MeToo Moment" without mentioning #ChurchToo haha

Honestly I mean at least 14 months in they are admitting we exist at all, for the longest it was just article after article about "Evangelicalism's #MeToo Moment" conveniently covering all the same stories and talking to all the same people #ChurchToo https://t.co/jx5Zdu5iqg

As one person in my mentions brought up this probably has in large part to do with rebranding himself in the age of #MeToo/#ChurchToo and separating himself from the sex abuse scandals of Sovereign Grace Ministries. It's good if he can come off as the softer, apologetic one.
